prompt:
/software-design

The PRD for per-caller rate limiting is at .scratch/prd.md and the published backlog is under .scratch/issues/ (001, 002, 003). Produce the Design Plan for this backlog: name the modules, locate the seams, define the testing strategy, and rewrite the three issue bodies into TDD-ready form. Write the Design Plan to .scratch/design-plan.md and update the issue files in place.
rubric: Names concrete modules and locates seams at sensible boundaries (e.g. a RateLimiter seam consulted by the HTTP layer, domain logic unaware).
Defines a testing strategy that exploits the seams (injectable clock for the bucket, fake limiter for HTTP).
Rewrites the three issues into TDD-ready bodies with clear behavioral acceptance.
Respects the existing domain vocabulary from CONTEXT.md (Link, slug, mint, resolve, Caller).
Prefers existing seams/modules over inventing new ones; new seams proposed at the highest sensible point.
